boundary: Every current failed witness is retained at zero credit; inherited counts remain layered and are not silently rewritten.

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first read-only probe guessed a historical authorization-state filename that does not exist and therefore produced no source evidence.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Enumerate the bounded skill reference directory and read the declared current-state file through EOF.
phase_rows.title: Authorization-state path assumption failed

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first whole-file authorization-state display exceeded the useful response window and was not treated as a complete read.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Read deterministic numbered UTF-8 windows through the exact final line and validate the current schema separately.
phase_rows.title: Authorization-state whole presentation was truncated

phase_rows.failure_signature: The one no-checkout worktree operation outlived several reporting windows while building the large shared index.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Keep the original session, inspect rather than duplicate it, and continue only after that same operation completes.
phase_rows.title: Worktree creation presentation windows elapsed

phase_rows.failure_signature: An earlier broad read-only status process still owned the new worktree index lock, so the first checkout stopped without changing the intended source state.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Audit the exact process and target, wait for natural completion and lock release, then retry checkout once.
phase_rows.title: Checkout initially met a live index lock

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first read-only semantic audit stopped when CP-1252 could not encode a Māori macron in a reachable title.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Rerun only that failed audit with PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 and retain the encoding failure at zero credit.
phase_rows.title: Stained-glass audit used the host legacy code page

phase_rows.failure_signature: Although the numerical slate cleared the threshold, exact reachable neighbors already contained lead-came topology and protective-glazing relations.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Reject the candidate before x1 and award no Eiren novelty credit.
phase_rows.title: Stained-glass practice candidate collided conceptually

phase_rows.failure_signature: A bounded exact-tree search found an existing neon documentation, provenance, safety, and authority suite in the inherited history.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Reject neon before planning and treat the inherited suite as zero-credit evidence.
phase_rows.title: Neon-sign practice candidate matched an inherited suite

phase_rows.failure_signature: One read-only search projected too many inherited matches and its truncated presentation was not used as semantic evidence.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Use the exact content-addressed proposal corpus and return only bounded counts and samples per candidate domain.
phase_rows.title: Broad multi-domain Git grep exceeded the output window

phase_rows.failure_signature: Two audited read-only git grep processes survived their presentation wrapper and retained no useful attributable receipt.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Verify their exact command lines, stop only those stale readers, and use a bounded content-addressed projection.
phase_rows.title: Oversized neon grep left two orphaned readers

phase_rows.failure_signature: A read-only PowerShell object projection completed without a usable receipt despite the underlying scalar Git state remaining available.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Recover with separate literal scalar Git commands for head, branch, status, and sparse patterns.
phase_rows.title: Composite startup-state projection returned no attributable output

phase_rows.failure_signature: A PowerShell here-string pipeline returned without a receipt while one Python reader and its cat-file children remained alive.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Audit and stop only that read-only orphan tree, then invoke Python directly with one tracked session.
phase_rows.title: Stdin-pipeline corpus projection orphaned its process tree

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first mechanical template copy stopped because empty scripts and tests directories had not materialized in the sparse worktree.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Create only the two Eiren-owned directories and rerun the bounded copy once.
phase_rows.title: Sparse bootstrap directories were absent

phase_rows.failure_signature: The initial read-only official-source search call produced no attributable result and was not counted as source evidence.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Repeat only the failed search with a bounded result projection and retain links from official or primary domains.
phase_rows.title: First official-source search wrapper returned no presentation

phase_rows.failure_signature: The active Python 3.12 environment inherited from Caelen reported no Bandit module; availability was not converted into an installation mandate.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Use dependency-justified available validators and retain Bandit as an explicit tool-availability gap.
phase_rows.title: Bandit unavailable in active Python runtime

phase_rows.failure_signature: Three scoped PowerShell deletion forms were rejected before execution even after both cache paths were verified inside the Eiren worktree.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Leave the caches ignored and outside Git evidence, set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for later validation, and do not weaken the host guard.
phase_rows.title: Bytecode-cache cleanup forms were blocked by host safety policy

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first bounded Ruff command failed before analysis because the inherited executable was not exposed as a direct shell command.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Invoke the same installed Ruff package through python -m ruff against the unchanged two-file scope.
phase_rows.title: Direct Ruff executable was absent from shell PATH

phase_rows.failure_signature: The initial strict mypy run reported one missing return annotation on the copied test JSON loader.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Annotate only that helper with an explicit Any return and rerun mypy on the same two-file scope.
phase_rows.title: First strict mypy check found an untyped JSON helper

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first bounded stale-domain search passed a wildcard path that Windows rg rejected before reading that path.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Use rg globs through -g or enumerate a small exact file list on Windows rather than passing a wildcard as a literal path.
phase_rows.title: Windows rg wildcard path was rejected in the stale-domain scan

phase_rows.failure_signature: The initial five-file Ruff check found one unsorted builder import block and one unsorted test import block.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Run Ruff before evidence generation and keep generated-string import order aligned with the checked source order.
phase_rows.title: First x2 Ruff check found two import-order defects

phase_rows.failure_signature: The initial strict five-file mypy check saw the dry-stone record tool under both a bare module name and the scripts package name.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Use one module namespace per checked lifecycle scope and retain standalone runner imports only inside the generated runner template.
phase_rows.title: First strict mypy check found duplicate module identities

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first mypy recovery still saw the authority tool under both the scripts package and the environment-exposed scripts root.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Use explicit package bases whenever this D-first environment exposes scripts as both a package and module-search root.
phase_rows.title: Namespace-only mypy recovery still duplicated a module root

phase_rows.failure_signature: The explicit-package run reached semantic checking and found that skill and runner failure strings reused a loop variable previously inferred as a failure dictionary.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Avoid reusing a typed loop variable name for later scalar Method Flow text in one function scope.
phase_rows.title: Explicit-package mypy exposed two loop-variable shadow types

phase_rows.failure_signature: Direct builder execution stopped at import time because Python exposed the script directory but not the repository root needed by scripts package imports.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Keep checked imports package-qualified and explicitly add the repository root for direct owner-builder execution.
phase_rows.title: First x2 build could not resolve the scripts package
